abstract: Sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) is the most common congenital tumor, with affected fetuses having a high risk of perinatal complications and death. We report a case of a fetus with an SCT that developed acute anemia due to spontaneous rupture of the tumor in utero. The fetus was referred at 25 weeks' gestation for evaluation of a large solid and cystic mass in the sacral region. There were no signs of hydrops or placentomegaly. At 33 weeks' gestation, loss of variability in the fetal heart rate pattern was recorded. Doppler ultrasonography showed increased middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity, suggesting fetal anemia. Markedly bloody amniotic fluid, with 82% hemoglobin F, was observed on amniocentesis, suggesting rupture of the SCT with active fetal bleeding. An emergency Cesarean section was performed. At delivery, the tumor was bleeding actively and the neonatal hemoglobin concentration was 3.1 g/dL. There were no findings of hemorrhage or necrosis within the tumor. The neonate received a blood transfusion, and surgical resection of the tumor was carried out on the first day after delivery. Postoperatively, the baby did well. We suggest that fetal SCTs run the risk of inducing acute fetal anemia due to intrauterine hemorrhage of the tumor, a finding which could lead to an earlier and more appropriate management of this condition.
abstract_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）は最も一般的な先天性腫瘍であり、罹患胎児は周産期合併症および死亡のリスクが高い。我々は、子宮内での腫瘍の自然破裂により急性貧血を生じた胎児例を報告する。胎児は妊娠25週で、仙骨部の大きな充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤の評価のため紹介された。水腫や胎盤肥大の所見はなかった。妊娠33週で胎児心拍パターンの変動消失が記録された。ドプラ超音波検査で中大脳動脈最大収縮期血流速度の上昇を認め、胎児貧血が示唆された。羊水穿刺では血性羊水（ヘモグロビンF 82%）が認められ、SCTの破裂と活動性の胎児出血が示唆された。緊急帝王切開が施行された。分娩時、腫瘍は活動的に出血しており、新生児のヘモグロビン濃度は3.1 g/dLであった。腫瘍内に出血や壊死の所見はなかった。新生児は輸血を受け、出生後1日目に腫瘍の外科的切除が行われた。術後は経過良好であった。胎児SCTは子宮内出血により急性胎児貧血を誘発するリスクがあると考える。この知見は、本疾患のより早期かつ適切な管理につながりうる。
